problem: The live pricing page could render and pricing taps could respond while English switching still failed because the browser called /api/i18n-translate and Netlify returned 404.
root_cause: The i18n runtime and Netlify function both used the /api/i18n-translate contract, but netlify.toml did not explicitly route that public path to /.netlify/functions/i18n-translate. Previous browser gates rendered pages but did not execute the language action and probe the API.
prevention: Netlify must explicitly route /api/i18n-translate to the i18n-translate function.
Website CI must perform real mobile pricing taps and actual English switching.
The browser gate must probe the i18n endpoint before accepting the language flow.
Pricing interaction proof must follow the current delegated ready-v2 runtime marker.
Production closure requires exact public /prijzen interaction readback after merge.
